unit.why: A first-person memorate quoted from Megillat Setarim: as a nine-year-old the Komarno rebbe was in Lublin with his father on Passover and saw fire blazing over the Seer's head.

stories.start_quote: במגלת סתרים למורי הגה״ק מוהרי״א מקומארנא
stories.summary_en: R. Yitzhak Eizik of Komarno recalls going to Lublin with his father, a disciple of the Seer, as a nine-year-old on Passover, seeing the Seer's face like torches and fire blazing on his head as he opened the door to say Kegavna, and witnessing his wondrous holy spirit and self-sacrificing worship.
